description: This file defines the 'TopicPath' interface, which models the structure and components of a topic path within the Ditto Protocol. It includes methods for constructing and parsing topic paths, as well as nested enums representing various fixed components (like groups, criteria, channels, actions, search actions) of the topic paths used in the system.

classes.name: TopicPath
classes.description: Interface representing the path of a topic for the Ditto Protocol, including methods for constructing, parsing, and inspecting topic path components, along with nested enums for fixed path components.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing TopicPath instances, based on a ThingId, PolicyId, or a String namespace.

methods.name: fromNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new builder from a namespace string.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace portion of the topic path.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group component of the topic path (e.g., 'things' or 'policies').

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel component of the topic path (e.g., 'twin', 'live', 'none').

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the action component (e.g., 'create', 'modify') if present.

methods.name: getSearchAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the search action component if present.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the subject component if present.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name part of the path.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the full path string of the TopicPath.

methods.name: isWildcardTopic
methods.description: Returns true if the topic ID is a wildcard placeholder '_'.
